standards.scope: Grades 2–8, L.grade.4b; Grades 2–3 also 4c; context 4a for meaning/transfer objectives. Paraphrases, conditional task connections, not endorsements or mastery decisions.

sequence.summary: Inflections preceded derivations; transparent forms preceded sound/spelling shifts; free bases preceded bound bases; taught bases preceded untaught bases for transfer.
sequence.limit: Study-specific intervention order in Grades 4–6 children with dyslexia; not a universal optimal sequence or an official grade-by-grade morpheme list.

objective_authorship: First Volo examples rewritten around observable target responses; no copied goal-bank paragraphs. Criterion, schedule, supports and date require individualization.
research_bank_scope: Existing 15 Flight/objective research mappings retained. This release did not independently re-audit every prior intervention claim. Standards and the named sequence section were checked against primary sources.
